## Pull request overview

This PR enhances the NavigationDesigner component with four major capabilities aligned with the Navigation Tree Designer spec: icon editing, visibility toggle, schema export/import, and responsive mobile layout. The implementation follows the codebase's i18n patterns and test-driven development approach.

**Changes:**
- Added inline icon editing with pencil button trigger and Enter/Escape commit/discard workflow
- Added visibility toggle button (Eye/EyeOff icons) with hidden badge display for items marked `visible: false`
- Added Export/Import JSON Schema toolbar buttons with file I/O and optional callback props (`onExport`, `onImport`)
- Responsive layout changes: `flex-col` on mobile, `sm:flex-row` on desktop
- 9 new i18n keys across all 10 locales (103 total keys in appDesigner section)
- 15 new tests covering all new features (33 total tests, from 18 baseline)

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 14 out of 14 changed files in this pull request and generated 3 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/plugin-designer/src/NavigationDesigner.tsx | Core implementation: icon editing input, visibility toggle logic, export/import handlers, responsive flex classes, new props interface (onExport/onImport) |
| packages/plugin-designer/src/__tests__/NavigationDesigner.test.tsx | Test coverage: 4 icon editing tests, 4 visibility toggle tests, 4 export/import tests, 1 responsive layout test, read-only guards |
| packages/plugin-designer/src/hooks/useDesignerTranslation.ts | Added 9 fallback i18n keys (navEditIcon, navToggleVisible, navHidden, navExportSchema, navImportSchema, navExportSuccess, navImportSuccess, navImportError, navIconPlaceholder) |
| packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts (10 files) | Added 9 translated keys to all 10 locales (en, zh, ja, de, fr, es, ar, ru, pt, ko) |
| ROADMAP.md | Updated P1.11 checklist: added 4 feature bullets, updated i18n key count (94→103), test count (18→33, 165→180 total) |
</details>

Three i18n keys are defined but never used in the code: `navExportSuccess`, `navImportSuccess`, and `navImportError`. The export/import functionality silently downloads/uploads files without providing user feedback. Consider either using these keys to show toast notifications or status messages, or remove them to avoid maintaining unused translations across 10 locales.
